title: CXOTalk Episode 923 — 'Can You Build an Incorruptible AI Company?'
summary: Michael Krigsman hosts Eric for an hour-long live conversation on whether an AI company can take outside investment and still stay independent of its investors' demands — covering financial gravity, how to lock a mission into a legal structure under real financial pressure, what Anthropic's mission structures reveal in practice and where they fail, and what enterprise buyers should examine in how their AI vendors are funded and governed.
blockquote: Growth, outside capital, and the race to monetize all pull AI companies toward easy money. Eric Ries on whether a company can resist that pull and stay true to its mission as it scales.
